The online application process started on 03 August 2026 .

The Examination will begin on 29 November 2026.
Q3. Where can I find the syllabus for the IIM CAT Admission Examination?
The detailed syllabus and examination scheme are available in the official notification. Candidates are advised to read the notification carefully for complete details.
Q4. How can I download the IIM CAT Admission 2026 Notification PDF?
Candidates can download the notification through SarkariResult.com.

The last date to apply online is 15 September 2026.
Q6. What is the last date to IIM CAT Admission pay the application fee?
Candidates can pay the application fee up to 15 September 2026 .
